verdict.label: Prices falling
verdict.headline: Card prices are falling: hold your coins and buy only cards you will play.
verdict.detail: Ezzcoins' Top 100 index is 108.0 (-1.8% in a day) and momentum is 39: prices are falling. 84s cost 950, 85s 2,800 and 86s 5,700. It is Champions weekend, when meta cards usually sell best.

index.note: Ezzcoins' own index from live console prices, read at {{t:2026-10-24T18:01:00+01:00}}.

moves.title: Sell João Félix 84 Team of the week after its 17% fall, expect it lower in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 224,000 coins. Now 181,000. Sell the slide: a playable card that fell sharply in a day often keeps falling for another two days. Picked because it is down 16.7% in about a day. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This strategy is 1 of 2 so far, averaging +8.3% after tax. A sell call is a hit if the price is lower at check time.

moves.title: Sell Pedro Neto 83 Team of the week after its 66% fall, expect it lower in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 82,000 coins. Now 98,000. Sell the slide: a playable card that fell sharply in a day often keeps falling for another two days. Picked because it is down 66.4% in about a day. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This is the strategy's first tracked call. A sell call is a hit if the price is lower at check time.

moves.title: Champions weekend: sell spare meta cards, keep the ones you play
moves.detail: Meta cards usually sell best during the weekend. Selling and rebuying cards you play costs the 5% tax and a higher weekend price.

moves.title: Fodder: 84s are the best value per point, 87s the dearest
moves.detail: Cheapest prices: 84s 950 (1.14 coins per Item Score point), 85s 2,800 (1.33 coins per Item Score point), 86s 5,700 (1.39 coins per Item Score point), 87s 7,800 (1.42 coins per Item Score point), 88s 10,000 (1.20 coins per Item Score point). For SBCs that ask for an Item Score, 84s then 88s fill it cheapest. Use fodder in SBCs rather than trading it: selling costs the 5% tax.

moves.title: Kieran Tierney and other falling cards: wait for the fall to flatten
moves.detail: Biggest falls in the last day: Kieran Tierney 77 Rare -53.3%; João Félix 84 Team of the week -35.6%; Gastón Álvarez 75 Rare -34.1%; Georges-Kévin Nkoudou 78 Rare -33.9%. Buy only cards you will play, and wait for two steady updates before buying.
